## Coming from BacaKomik?
On Android, Yoru is a new app next to BacaKomik. Before you uninstall BacaKomik, bring your library over: sync it with Drive in BacaKomik and sign in to Drive sync in Yoru, or back it up in BacaKomik and restore the file in Yoru (More → Backup & sync). The 2.17.0 notes have the details.

## Changes

### Fixed
- The public extension repo loads again. It moved to `https://sofyan-rs.github.io/yoru-ext-public-source/index.json`, and a repo saved under its old address now uses the new one.

### Changed
- New backup files are named `yoru-backup-….json`, and saved images `yoru_…`. Backups made by BacaKomik still restore.
- MangaDex 1.3.5 (from the extension repo) names Yoru when it asks MangaDex for data.
